name: How to Compress a PDF Free
description: Reduce PDF file size without losing quality — free, no upload, processed entirely in your browser.

tool.name: PDFree — free browser-based PDF compressor, no upload required

step.name: Open your PDF
step.text: Click 'Choose files' or drag your PDF into the drop zone. Any file size is accepted — the file loads in your browser and is never uploaded.

step.name: Choose a compression level
step.text: Select Light (removes metadata only, images unchanged), Standard (removes metadata and recompresses images — best for most files), or Maximum (most aggressive — best for scanned documents). PDFree analyses your PDF and recommends the best preset automatically.

step.name: Compress and download
step.text: Click 'Compress PDF'. Processing takes seconds in your browser. A compression report shows exactly what was removed — XMP metadata, thumbnails, duplicate images, and recompressed streams. Download the smaller PDF immediately.
